quiz.ja: ワニのおくさんは、何を食べたいと言いましたか。

explain.vi: Bà vợ nghĩ tim khỉ còn ngọt hơn quả.
explain.en: She thought the monkey's heart would be even sweeter.
explain.ko: 원숭이 심장이 더 달 거라고 생각했다.
explain.tl: Inakala niyang mas matamis ang puso ng unggoy.
explain.ne: उसले बाँदरको मुटु अझ गुलियो होला ठानी।
explain.id: Ia mengira jantung monyet lebih manis.
explain.pt: Achou que o coração do macaco seria mais doce.
explain.my: မျောက်နှလုံးက ပိုချိုမယ်ထင်တယ်။
explain.th: นางคิดว่าหัวใจลิงหวานกว่า

quiz.ja: サルはどうやってワニの家へ行こうとしましたか。

explain.vi: Khỉ không biết bơi nên cưỡi lưng cá sấu.
explain.en: The monkey can't swim, so he rode on the crocodile's back.
explain.zh-Hans: 猴子不会游泳，就骑在鳄鱼背上。
explain.ko: 헤엄을 못 쳐서 악어 등에 탔다.
explain.tl: Hindi marunong lumangoy ang unggoy kaya sumakay sa likod.
explain.id: Monyet tak bisa berenang, jadi naik punggung buaya.
explain.pt: Como não sabia nadar, subiu nas costas do crocodilo.
explain.th: ลิงว่ายน้ำไม่เป็น จึงขี่หลังจระเข้

quiz.ja: サルは心臓がどこにあると言いましたか。

explain.vi: Khỉ bịa rằng tim để trên cây.
explain.en: The monkey claimed he'd left it in the tree.
explain.ko: 원숭이는 나무 위에 두었다고 꾸며 댔다.
explain.tl: Sinabi ng unggoy na naiwan ito sa puno.
explain.id: Monyet berdalih jantungnya di atas pohon.
explain.pt: O macaco inventou que o deixara na árvore.
explain.my: မျောက်က သစ်ပင်ပေါ်မှာ ထားခဲ့တယ်လို့ လိမ်တယ်။
explain.th: ลิงอ้างว่าทิ้งไว้บนต้นไม้

quiz.ja: この話で大切なことは何ですか。
choices: 困ったときこそ、あわてないで考えること
友だちに心臓をあげること

explain.vi: Câu 45: lúc khó khăn càng phải bình tĩnh.
explain.en: Line 45: stay calm and think, especially in trouble.
explain.zh-Hans: 第45句：越困难越要冷静思考。
explain.id: Kalimat 45: justru saat sulit harus tenang.
explain.pt: Frase 45: nos apuros, manter a calma.
explain.th: ประโยค 45: ยามลำบากต้องตั้งสติ
